summary.text: Ron Johnson was elected to the U.S. Senate from Wisconsin in 2010 and was re-elected to a third term in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate he ran a manufacturing business in Oshkosh, Wisconsin, for thirty years.
He chairs the Senate Committee on the Budget and chaired the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs from 2015 to 2021.
He lives in Oshkosh with his wife Jane.
